experiments.title: Lighthouse Storm: two local, two cloud
experiments.alt: Four-panel lighthouse storm comparison: DeepSeek, Astra, GLM, Fable
experiments.label: Astra / GLM-5.3 / Fable 5 / DeepSeek V4.1
experiments.description: An underspecified Three.js brief finally separates the models. Astra runs away with it; GLM proves two Sparks can hang; DeepSeek forgets the ocean.
experiments.disclosure: Cloud arms untimed · DeepSeek TP2 not TP4 · GLM node crash disclosed

experiments.title: Asteroids: one memorized game
experiments.alt: Stacked Asteroids gameplay from DeepSeek and GLM
experiments.label: DeepSeek V4.1 / GLM-5.3 Flash
experiments.description: Same prompt, ultra reasoning, two Spark pairs — and two nearly identical games. A lesson in what a classic-game prompt actually tests.
experiments.disclosure: Identical scripted inputs · different worlds · no repairs

experiments.title: Water, three ways
experiments.alt: Three-panel water comparison with Astra, DeepSeek Cloud and DeepSeek Local
experiments.label: Astra / DeepSeek V4.1
experiments.description: One water prompt through ChatGPT, the official API and a local Hermes agent. Watch the outputs and inspect the timing caveats.
experiments.disclosure: Different workflows · not a controlled speed benchmark

experiments.title: Fire in a Glass Box
experiments.alt: Qwen-generated fire inside a glass box
experiments.label: Qwen Flash-Next / AEON / MLX
experiments.description: From the first spark to wind-driven blowout. Three local deployments tackle the same fire simulation, with repairs disclosed.

experiments.title: Qwen vs Ling: pagoda showdown
experiments.alt: Qwen Flash-Next pagoda from the Ling comparison
experiments.label: Qwen Flash-Next / Ling Flash VL
experiments.description: A dense district-planned garden meets a compact colorful pagoda. Two model families, two engines, one creative brief.
experiments.disclosure: Different engines · requested effort is not equivalent policy

experiments.title: Nex vs Ling
experiments.alt: Nex generated pagoda scene after its disclosed two-line repair
experiments.label: Nex-N2.5-mini / Ling Flash VL
experiments.description: The original, the repaired scene and the exact diff. A reminder that generating HTML is not the same as shipping a working world.
experiments.disclosure: Nex: two missing declarations fixed · original downloadable

experiments.title: Voxel Island: the missing third result
experiments.alt: Qwen Flash-Next generated floating voxel island
experiments.label: Qwen Flash-Next / MLX / AEON
experiments.description: Two floating islands and an AEON arm that failed to finish a usable artifact. Model failures and harness failures stay separate.
experiments.disclosure: Mac repair disclosed · failed AEON attempts documented

experiments.title: Voxel Pagodas
experiments.alt: Model-generated voxel pagoda and surrounding garden
experiments.label: Qwen / GLM / DeepSeek + more
experiments.description: Explore each model’s pagoda garden, from koi ponds to drifting petals. Switch models and orbit the actual outputs.
experiments.disclosure: Includes disclosed display repairs and failed runs

experiments.title: Floating City
experiments.alt: GLM-generated floating voxel city with a clock tower and airships
experiments.label: Qwen3.8 / GLM-5.2 / Qwen3.6
experiments.description: Clock towers, airships and islands above the clouds. One prompt, very different interpretations of a floating world.
experiments.disclosure: Originals and display-repaired variants identified in archive

experiments.title: Neon Highway
experiments.label: Qwen
experiments.description: A midnight run through Tokyo. Drive, drift, switch the camera, and put a model-generated game through its paces.

experiments.title: Brick Terra
experiments.alt: Brick Terra voxel terrain editor with water and vegetation
experiments.label: Voxel terrain / physics
experiments.description: Paint the landscape, send water downhill, and watch a small world respond. An interactive terraforming diorama.

experiments.title: Flash vs Full 743B
experiments.alt: GLM Flash and Full solar-system comparison
experiments.label: GLM-5.3 Flash / Full
experiments.description: Two-Spark Flash meets four-Spark Full on the same solar-system brief. Explore both interactive orreries.
experiments.disclosure: Flash display repair disclosed · original preserved

experiments.title: Galaxy Battle
experiments.label: GLM-5.3 Flash / Qwen3.8
experiments.description: Two long-reasoning models turn a shared brief into interactive galaxies. Inspect the details beyond the hero shot.

experiments.title: Origami Dragon
experiments.label: GLM-5.3 Flash / Qwen3.8
experiments.description: Paper folds, transforms and takes flight. A test of geometry, motion and whether the ambitious brief survives rendering.

experiments.title: Storm in a Glass Cube
experiments.alt: GLM-generated storm installation inside a glass cube
experiments.label: GLM-5.3 Flash / Qwen3.8
experiments.description: A quiet museum object becomes a miniature supercell. Compare the generated scenes and watch the recordings.

experiments.title: One family, three pagodas
experiments.alt: A voxel pagoda from the Qwen model family
experiments.label: Qwen Flash-Next / Max / 27B
experiments.description: Flash-Next, Max at 1-bit and a smaller 27B model tackle the same garden. Different deployment sizes, visible trade-offs.
experiments.disclosure: Flash-Next render fix disclosed on experiment page

experiments.title: Flappy Bird: 1-bit vs 4-bit
experiments.label: Qwen3.6-27B / Bonsai
experiments.description: A useful counterexample: the 1-bit version never became a working game, even after follow-up attempts. The broken output stays public.
experiments.disclosure: Includes failed output and follow-up attempts

research.title: GLM Flash, official NVIDIA NVFP4
research.label: 2× DGX Spark / DFlash2 / diagnostic recipe
research.description: Measured acceleration and long-input retrieval, with output-quality caveats. The drafter carries a noncommercial license; this is not production certification.

research.title: Qwen Flash-Next, FP8 on two Sparks
research.label: DGX Spark / vLLM / native MTP
research.description: The local serving recipe behind recent long-thinking visuals. Configuration, runtime evidence and practical deployment limits—not a context-free speed claim.

research.title: Ling-3.0 Flash VL, day-zero serving
research.label: 2× DGX Spark / FP8 / SGLang
research.description: A vision-native model on a development serving stack. Includes a sustained pagoda generation and the setup needed to reproduce it.

research.title: Native MTP vs DFlash on Mac
research.label: Mac Studio / Qwen3.8-27B / MLX
research.description: A short-prompt acceleration study with a 4-bit/8-bit follow-up. Serialization and correctness caveats matter as much as the measured throughput.

research.title: When a serving recipe changes the score
research.label: GLM-5.3 Flash EXL3 / Mia recipe / historical evidence
research.description: Two pinned recipe revisions, full transcripts and a template-regression investigation. Environment and grader differences are disclosed in the evidence pack.

research.title: DeepSeek Vision-Exp on Apple Silicon
research.label: Mac Studio / DwarfStar / DSpark
research.description: A native C + Metal deployment, pagoda artifact and repair record. Configured context capacity is separate from filled-context performance.

research.title: The Qwen quantization ladder
research.label: DGX Spark / NVFP4 · FP8 · GGUF · BF16
research.description: Explore precision, engine and speculative-decoding trade-offs. These are deployment comparisons, not a claim that only quantization changed.

research.title: Reproduce a visual comparison
research.label: Matched prompts / raw streams / browser artifacts
research.description: The portable harness for preserving model responses, comparing generated HTML and keeping repairs separate from the original output.
